question: In a certain code language, 'JOCKEY' is written as 'KCJYOE'. How will 'EXCISE' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2279c21b248cf244ce9c66a353413ffa1a01afa396a02423895bd343ac1e758.png] 

**JOCKEY: KCJYOE**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e435dd91c194e06dee1a165067ee51a606db215080a4980a6a2bdc4bad0a8cca.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05acabf1f112e10f15fabd11686b94a26f9470ecfaa91dc4649851fc7f47b983.png] 

Similarly,

**EXCISE: ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2ee329011b008aed2fa30e6219cd82e5607999b308b1c5fd3a3b1d2ef9ef3b2.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2831ee6d6e4c6b423fae4c1198a5b4f88ed0b369aff22b98faf8507017eb858.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****ICEEXS"**.
